digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI

teaser.en: Its leaves are as rough as sandpaper, and its Digo name, 'wiper of the pig's buttocks', makes sure nobody forgets it.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yana ukwaru kama msasa, na jina lake la Kidigo, 'mpanguzaji wa makalio ya nguruwe', huhakikisha hakuna anayelisahau.

summary.en: *Mzondohera nguluwe* is a bushland shrub with leaves as rough as sandpaper and orange fruits that sit in a little saucer. Its memorable Digo name is one of the best examples of Digo humour in plant naming.
summary.sw: *Mzondohera nguluwe* ni kichaka cha nyika ya vichaka chenye majani yenye ukwaru kama karatasi ya msasa na matunda ya rangi ya chungwa yanayokaa kwenye kisahani kidogo. Jina lake la Kidigo lisilosahaulika ni mojawapo ya mifano bora ya ucheshi wa Kidigo katika kuipa mimea majina.

about.en:
*Mzondohera nguluwe* is a shrub or small tree whose leaves are its signature. Run a hand over one and it feels like fine sandpaper, rough on both sides. The leaves are broad and rounded.

The fruits are small, round and orange when ripe, and each one sits in a cup or saucer formed by the old flower calyx. That saucer is what gives it the English name 'sandpaper saucer-berry'. Inside is a sticky, translucent pulp around a hard stone, typical of the *Cordia* genus.
about.sw:
*Mzondohera nguluwe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo ambao majani yake ndiyo alama yake kuu. Ukipitisha mkono juu ya jani moja, unahisi kama karatasi laini ya msasa, lenye ukwaru pande zote mbili. Majani ni mapana na ya mviringo.

Matunda ni madogo, ya mviringo na ya rangi ya chungwa yakiiva, na kila moja hukaa kwenye kikombe au kisahani kilichoundwa na kaliksi ya zamani ya ua. Kisahani hicho ndicho kinachoupa jina la Kiingereza *sandpaper saucer-berry*. Ndani kuna nyama angavu inayonata inayozunguka kokwa gumu, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa jenasi *Cordia*.

where.en: This is a plant of the coastal bushland, growing among other thorny and rough-leaved shrubs in the dry bush inland from the beaches. It is easiest to spot when the orange fruits are ripe.
where.sw: Huu ni mmea wa nyika ya vichaka ya pwani, unaokua miongoni mwa vichaka vingine vyenye miiba na majani yenye ukwaru katika vichaka vikavu vilivyo bara kutoka fukweni. Ni rahisi zaidi kuutambua matunda yake ya rangi ya chungwa yanapoiva.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded. Elsewhere in East Africa the ripe fruits of this species are eaten for their sweet, sticky pulp, and the rough leaves are used to smooth wood and scour pots.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Kwingineko Afrika Mashariki, matunda yaliyoiva ya spishi hii huliwa kwa nyama yake tamu inayonata, na majani yenye ukwaru hutumika kulainisha mbao na kusugua vyungu.

culture.en: The name *mzondohera nguluwe* means 'wiper of the pig's buttocks', a joke that follows naturally from leaves as rough as these. Names like this, built on everyday images, help people remember what a plant feels like.
culture.sw: Jina *mzondohera nguluwe* lina maana ya 'mpanguzaji wa makalio ya nguruwe', utani unaotokana kwa urahisi na majani yenye ukwaru kama haya. Majina kama haya, yaliyojengwa juu ya taswira za kila siku, huwasaidia watu kukumbuka jinsi mmea unavyohisika ukiguswa.

names.en: Digo: *mzondohera nguluwe*. The same name is also recorded for a quite different plant, the climber *mkala fisi* (*Tetracera boiviniana*), which also has sandpapery leaves, so the name seems to describe the leaf rather than a single species. English: sandpaper saucer-berry. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mzondohera nguluwe*. Jina hilo hilo pia limerekodiwa kwa mmea tofauti kabisa, mtambaa *mkala fisi* (*Tetracera boiviniana*), ambao pia una majani kama msasa, kwa hiyo jina hili linaonekana kueleza jani badala ya spishi moja. Kiingereza: *sandpaper saucer-berry*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Shares the name mzondohera nguluwe for its rough leaves
reason.sw: Unashiriki jina *mzondohera nguluwe* kwa sababu ya majani yake yenye ukwaru
Msasa, mmea mwingine wenye majani yenye ukwaru

reason.en: Fellow bushland shrub with small fruits
reason.sw: Kichaka mwenzake cha nyika ya vichaka chenye matunda madogo
